content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment simplifies the sales process for digital creators. Instead of relying on traditional payment processors that charge excessive fees, this system leverages low-cost solutions like NOWPayments, which takes only a 0.5% fee compared to Gumroad's 10%. This means creators keep more of their hard-earned revenue, enabling them to reinvest in their work and grow their business sustainably. The ability to deliver products automatically upon payment confirmation minimizes manual work and enhances customer experience, making it essential for any creator looking to thrive in the digital marketplace.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure behind automated ebook delivery is composed of several key components that work seamlessly together. At its core, it utilizes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting the digital store, while backend logic is handled by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Orders are stored efficiently in Supabase or Google Sheets, allowing for easy tracking and management. When a customer completes a crypto payment through NOWPayments, a webhook automatically triggers the delivery of the ebook, ensuring that the customer receives their purchase immediately. This architecture is designed to be low-cost, scalable, and fully under the creator's control.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this infrastructure enables you to maintain ownership and control over every transaction. It's ideal for those who want to break free from the limitations imposed by traditional platforms that charge high fees or impose restrictive policies. The sovereignty of this architecture ensures that you are not dependent on any third-party service, giving you the freedom to operate your business as you see fit.
Automate your ebook sales to save time and reduce manual efforts.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The primary components of this infrastructure include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages for cost-effective deployment, NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing, and automated delivery mechanisms such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Each element is chosen for its reliability and efficiency, allowing creators to set up their stores quickly and without ongoing fees. The integration of Supabase or Google Sheets for order management ensures that every purchase is tracked accurately, while automatic delivery of digital products enhances the customer experience. Together, these components create a cohesive system that supports digital creators in their sales efforts.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying your automated ebook delivery system, first, choose your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing. Integrate your order management system, selecting either Supabase or Google Sheets based on your preference. Connect NOWPayments to manage crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept multiple cryptocurrencies. Finally, configure your automated delivery process so that ebooks are sent to customers immediately after payment confirmation. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the blueprints and templates needed to simplify this deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is possible through a sovereign infrastructure that utilizes automated delivery and crypto payments. By leveraging NOWPayments, creators can process transactions with minimal fees, ensuring they retain more revenue. This approach empowers digital creators to operate independently and efficiently, without relying on conventional payment platforms.
Retain more revenue with lower processing fees compared to traditional platforms.

For creators interested in building a fully operational online store, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to construct, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack effectively. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
